source='''def transform(grid):
    n = max(max(row) for row in grid)
    starts = [grid[r][0] for r in range(1, len(grid)) if grid[r][0] != 0]
    start = max(set(starts), key=starts.count)

    def value_at(k):
        return (start - 1 + k) % n + 1

    out = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        out.append([
            value_at(c if r > c else c - 1) if cell == 0 else cell
            for c, cell in enumerate(row)
        ])
    return out
'''
